question: Estimate monthly milk demand in a small town like Solapur (~12 lakh population).
idealClarificationQuestions: Liquid milk (packaged + loose + cooperative supplied) + dairy products? Liquid + value-added separately.
Solapur city only (not district)? City, ~12 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Per-capita milk consumption in Maharashtra: ~430 ml/day; Solapur (Tier 2 affluent): ~480 ml/day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Co-operative + branded packaged (Amul, Mother Dairy, Gokul, Warana): ~50% = ~87,000 kL.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Local dairies + private operators (loose milk, doodh-walas): ~50% = ~87,000 kL.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus value-added (curd, paneer, ghee, butter in milk-equivalent)
- Co-operative + branded packaged (Amul, Mother Dairy, Gokul, Warana)
- Local dairies + private operators (loose milk, doodh-walas)

calculationFlow: Daily milk demand Solapur city: 12 lakh × 480 ml = 5.76 lakh L/day.
Plus value-added (curd, paneer, ghee, butter in milk-equivalent): ~30% extra = ~2.2 lakh kL LME monthly.
- Co-operative + branded packaged (Amul, Mother Dairy, Gokul, Warana): ~50% = ~87,000 kL.
- Local dairies + private operators (loose milk, doodh-walas): ~50% = ~87,000 kL.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: - Local dairies + private operators (loose milk, doodh-walas): ~50% = ~87,000 kL.
